message.content:
**Pantone 14‑4318 TCX – “Sky Blue”**

This is the most widely recognized Pantone designation for a classic, light sky‑blue hue. It’s part of the Pantone TCX (Textile Color) series, which is commonly used for fabrics and textiles.

> **Pantone 14‑4318 TCX**  
> *Name:* Sky Blue  
> *Color family:* Light Blues  
> *Shade level:* 5/10 (moderate intensity)

---

### Quick Reference

| Context | Typical Pantone Code |
|---------|----------------------|
| Textile / Fabric | **14‑4318 TCX** |
| Graphic Design / Printing | **15‑4020 TPU** (a slightly deeper, more saturated version) |
| Interior Design | **13‑4102 TCX** (often referred to as “Light Sky Blue”) |

> **Note:** Pantone releases new color families each year, so the exact code may differ depending on the edition you’re referencing. If you need a precise match for a particular project, it’s best to consult the latest Pantone guide or use a Pantone color bridge chart to translate between the textile and process color systems.
